memglide_source_before.attestation: Prelaunch manifest retained the commit and aggregate source hash; original in-memory detailed metadata was lost on disconnect

memglide_source_after.scope: On-disk public Python source at capture time, not a proof of earlier runtime state

preflight_runs.scope: Original readiness call, excluded from task comparisons. Reparsed raw usage; original process timing/exit metadata lost on disconnect.

telemetry.source: codex exec --json; turn.completed usage and item lifecycle events
telemetry.usage_scope: Complete parsed stream only; partial observed turn usage is stored separately
telemetry.model_calls_unavailable_reason: Codex exec JSONL exposes completed turns, not underlying provider/API model calls
telemetry.actual_cost_unavailable_reason: Codex exec JSONL does not emit provider invoiced cost
telemetry.mcp_count_scope: Observed unique invocation items; total only for complete parsed streams, otherwise a lower bound
telemetry.repeated_file_reads_unavailable_reason: Codex JSONL does not expose a filesystem I/O trace; command text cannot establish actual reads
telemetry.file_read_method: Heuristic command-intent proxy from successful command_execution items containing literal cat, sed -n, head, tail, or rg commands with explicit file-like paths. Shell expansion, scripts, directory searches, MCP reads, and internal reads are excluded. A repeated command names a path recognized in an earlier command. This is not an I/O trace, an actual read count, or a guaranteed lower bound on filesystem reads.

recovery.policy: No original run is replaced. Original run90 remains an interrupted attempt in the main96. Continue remaining six original assignments using unchanged run_task and existing commits/schema/settings. Any later retry is separate supplemental evidence.
recovery.metadata_limitations: Original metadata was only written after all runs; its in-memory start timestamp and host snapshot were lost. Current host metadata below is a recovery-time observation. No reconstructed timestamp, timing, exit code or CPU value is presented as a measurement.

recovery_host.resource_scope: Local execution host; model inference resources are not exposed

methodology.repositories: Two synthetic multi-module Python/TypeScript fixtures, 24 IDs representing12 mirrored intents; external hidden oracles
methodology.isolation: Fresh detached worktrees from unchanged per-language seed commit; new state/index per B run
methodology.prompt:
Implement the requested change in this repository. Inspect the current source and run relevant tests. Preserve existing tests and Git metadata; do not commit. Do not access files outside this repository except installed development tools. The final structured response is only a summary, not a grading result.
If memglide MCP tools are available, use list_projects, start_session and get_context before editing, inspect the source evidence you need, and revalidate the Context Passport after edits. Otherwise use ordinary source tools. Do not claim token or cost savings.
methodology.settings: Same model/effort/schema/sandbox/instructions, only B required scoped Memglide MCP configuration differs
methodology.caching: Counterbalanced ordering across repeats. Provider and OS caches not flushable; cached tokens recorded. Execution interruption adds a disclosed pause before order91.
methodology.timing: Codex process plus B fresh-index timing; excludes grader and worktree preparation. Run90 timing unavailable after interruption.
methodology.cost: Provider billed cost/model-call counts unavailable; remain null
methodology.failed_runs: Original interruption retained in96 planned rows; no silent retries or replacement

source_snapshot_scope: Prelaunch recorded aggregate matches recovery/end snapshot. This is not continuous runtime attestation.
